Rank 01 - Training

Corporate AI Training and Workflow Automation

Bangladesh offices are hearing about AI, but most employees still need practical training: write better emails, summarize documents, prepare reports, automate Excel work, and create customer replies.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 30,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 3,000Recommended monthly charge

This is not a BDT 300/month product. Charge BDT 30,000-100,000 per company setup/training, then BDT 3,000-10,000/month for templates, support, and workflow updates.

9.6Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 30,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 3,000Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 6,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Start with SMEs, agencies, schools, clinics, accountants, exporters, and offices that already use Excel and email but do not know how to use AI safely at work.

Owners know AI is important, but staff waste time, use random tools, leak data, or cannot connect AI to daily office work.

Train your staff to use AI for real office work, without leaking data or wasting time.

Validation signals

  • Bangladesh training discussions now include AI and future-work skills.
  • Many offices still operate around Excel, email, Word, and manual reporting.
  • Corporate clients can pay more than micro shops.
  • Training opens the door to recurring software and automation retainers.

MVP modules

  • 2-day practical AI workshop for office staff
  • Bangla/English prompt templates
  • Excel, email, report, HR, sales, and customer-service workflows
  • Company AI policy starter kit
  • Monthly office-hours support
  • Private prompt library
  • Before/after productivity checklist

Do not build first

  • Do not sell a generic prompt-engineering certificate.
  • Do not teach only ChatGPT tricks.
  • Do not promise job guarantee or magic automation.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Create one AI-for-office demo day.
  • Sell to 10 SMEs at a founder price.
  • Collect each company's repeated document/report workflow.
  • Turn repeated workflows into templates and small software tools.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Companies may treat it as a one-time training.
  • Staff may forget after workshop.
  • Data privacy mistakes can hurt trust.
Mitigations
  • Bundle monthly office hours.
  • Provide reusable templates.
  • Teach strict data-safety rules.
